About this role

אנחנו מחפשים עובד/ת ניקיון אחראי/ת, עם גישה חיובית ורצון אמיתי לשמור על סטנדרט גבוה של ניקיון וסדר.

אז אם אחריות, סדר ויחסי אנוש טובים מדברים אליך – נשמח להכיר אותך!

העבודה הינה במשרדי החברה בחולון | משרה חלקית של 6 שעות ביום.

תחומי אחריות:
-ניקיון שוטף של משרדים, חדרי ישיבות, שירותים, אזורי ייצור, מטבחונים ומעברים.
-שמירה על רמה גבוהה של סדר, היגיינה ואסתטיקה בכלל שטחי החברה בהתאם לתוכנית עבודה קבועה.
-ביצוע ניקיונות תקופתיים: שטיפות רצפה, ניקוי חלונות, חיטוי אזורים ציבוריים.
-טיפול בזמינות ואספקה של חומרי ניקוי ונייר טואלט.
-דיווח מיידי על תקלות, נזילות או בעיות תחזוקה לאיש תחזוקה.
-סיוע בניקיון לפני פגישות ואירועים פנימיים.

דרישות התפקיד:
-ניסיון קודם בעבודות ניקיון במשרדים / אזורי ייצור – יתרון.
-יכולת עבודה עצמאית לפי לו”ז מוגדר.
-נכונות לעבודה מאומצת.
-אחריות, סדר וניקיון ברמה גבוהה.
-תודעת שירות גבוהה, גישה חיובית לעבודה.
-יחסי אנוש טובים ויכולת השתלבות בצוות.

description:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, designs and delivers high-end, custom silicon that sits at the very heart of AWS. Our devices don't just support the cloud — they actively define it. From Trainium, the purpose-built machine learning accelerator driving the next wave of AI innovation, to Graviton, the Arm-based server processor redefining price-performance for compute workloads, to Nitro, the advanced network and cloud management controller that powers every AWS instance — Annapurna's products consistently set the standard for the entire industry.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Amazon in developing the next generation of cloud products, in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment.

We are hiring a Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer to join the Signal Integrity and Packaging (SiP) group at Amazon's Annapurna Labs. This is a hands-on technical position for an experienced lab engineer who will lead characterization efforts for high-speed serial protocols in advanced semiconductor platforms.

You will design and execute comprehensive lab characterization campaigns, troubleshoot complex signal integrity issues, and drive data-driven optimization across PCIe, Ethernet, and other industry-standard serial interfaces. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong hardware debugging skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional design and validation teams.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead SerDes characterization campaigns for PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, and other serial protocols on advanced silicon and package platforms

- Design comprehensive test plans covering eye diagrams, bathtubs, jitter analysis and protocol compliance

- Operate and troubleshoot industry-standard lab equipment: oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and VNAs

- Analyze complex waveform and signal data; identify root causes of performance issues and signal integrity problems

- Collaborate with design teams to validate silicon behavior, debug hardware anomalies, and optimize link margins

- Develop characterization scripts and measurement techniques to improve efficiency and repeatability

- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to hardware design reviews from a characterization perspective

- Document findings and present technical results to stakeholders and leadership

A day in the life

As a Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer, you will own the lab characterization and validation of high-speed serial interfaces — from test plan definition and bench setup through silicon and board bring-up, link debug. You will work hands-on with oscilloscopes, VNAs and other test equipment.

You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including board design, packaging, ASIC, and firmware teams, to isolate link failures to their true source and drive them to closure. In addition, you will serve as the technical focal point for characterization on your projects — defining measurement methodology, making the judgement calls on what a marginal eye means, and setting the standard for how link margin is proven before silicon ships.

Basic qualifications
- 10+ years of hands-on lab characterization experience with SerDes protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, or equivalent high-speed serial interfaces)

- Expert-level proficiency with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and VNAs

- Deep understanding of signal integrity, jitter, eye diagrams, and link budget analysis

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in hardware bring-up and platform validation

- Experience with protocol compliance testing and standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or similar)

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent field with substantial lab experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience characterizing multiple SerDes protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe)

- Familiarity with high-speed package design, signal routing, and layout considerations

- Experience with automated measurement systems and scripting

- Background in silicon bring-up or hardware platform validation

Summary
We are seeking an experienced Signal/Image Processing and Machine Learning engineer to join our team. The role focuses on developing innovative, real-time deep learning and signal processing solutions for new sensing and imaging systems, including video restoration. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team developing technologies that will shape future Apple products.

Description
Algorithm and model development:
- Design, implement, and optimize signal processing and machine learning models for sensing and imaging tasks, including video restoration.
- Develop and validate models using real sensor data, simulated data, and public datasets.
- Prepare, filter, process, and analyze large-scale datasets to train and evaluate models.
- Analyze your algorithm's results and benchmark them against leading methods, and theoretical bounds.
- Optimize models for real-time performance, low latency, and resource efficiency on-device.

Sensing and research:
- Develop algorithms that combine classical signal processing with learned models to extract robust information from sensor data.
- Investigate efficient architecture patterns (lightweight backbones, attention mechanisms, recurrent designs) suitable for real-time, on-device inference.
- Explore how algorithmic approaches can mitigate artifacts and limitations of new sensing and imaging systems.
- Stay current with recent advances in signal processing, computer vision, and machine learning.

Collaboration and technical leadership:
- Work closely with ML researchers, SW, HW, sensor, and architecture engineers to translate research ideas into robust models and practical, shipping systems.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, and help shape the team's technical direction.

Responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end development of real-time algorithms, from concept and prototyping through validation and deployment.
- Define evaluation methodology, metrics, and failure analysis processes for sensing and imaging algorithms.
- Drive trade-off decisions among accuracy, latency, power, and memory across algorithm, HW, and system constraints.

Minimum qualifications
Strong foundation in signal processing, image processing, computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning.
Hands-on experience with sensing technologies (e.g., camera/image sensors, depth, radar, LiDAR, IMU, or other sensor modalities), including an understanding of sensor noise models and characteristics.
Demonstrated experience designing and deploying real-time deep learning and signal processing solutions using large-scale datasets.
Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch); experience with C++ or other performance-oriented languages is a plus.
Experience with model evaluation, debugging, experimental analysis, and failure analysis.
PhD or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related research field.
Proficient in written and verbal communication.
Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively.
8+ years of relevant experience

Preferred qualifications
Experience deploying models on GPU, dedicated HW, or neural engines, including quantization, pruning, and other model compression techniques.
Experience with multi-sensor fusion, sensor calibration, or temporal/streaming signal processing.
Experience with generative priors (diffusion, flow matching) is an advantage.
Background in signal processing, physics, optics, lasers is a plus.

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Responsibilities
- Work with partner teams to provide the compute, storage and methodology needs of the chip design, verification and physical design teams.

- Design and implement CAD tools, solutions and methodologies for ASIC development.

- Create software solutions that improve the hardware design process through automation.

- Propose, design and implement software automation that directly addresses bottlenecks in today's ASIC and SoC EDA flow.

- Leverage AI to both speed the development of tools and development flows, providing more natural and higher-efficiency ways for users to interact with developed technologies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience with hardware tools and flows.

- Experience with scripting for automation (e.g., shell, Python).

- 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms.
